module.purpose: Defines typed application errors and shared response/error-normalization helpers for library consumers.
module.summary: This module provides an Error subclass carrying an ErrorCode and optional metadata, a proxy-based factory for constructing coded errors dynamically, conversion of unknown thrown values into Error instances, and JSON or raw response handlers. Response helpers special-case gzip and HTTP 204 responses, log failed response bodies, and throw on unsuccessful status codes.
module.businessContext: Supports consistent error propagation across application services and API clients. Failures can obscure status codes, response bodies, or structured error metadata if these helpers break.
classes: ErrorWithCode (~L3-24): Error carrying a typed code, optional message, and metadata.
functions: getErrorFromUnknown (~L26-37): Normalizes arbitrary thrown values into Error-compatible instances.
handleErrorsJson (~L39-56): Parses successful responses or throws for unsuccessful HTTP responses.
handleErrorsRaw (~L58-68): Returns raw response text or throws for unsuccessful responses.

network: Consumes response body streams through response.text(), response.json(), and response headers.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An existing Error is supplied as the unknown cause.
moduleContractTests.then: the returned value is the same Error instance
moduleContractTests.rationale: Existing Error objects must retain identity and attached properties.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A string is supplied as the unknown cause.
moduleContractTests.rationale: String failures are converted into Error instances with the original message.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A successful response has HTTP status 204.
moduleContractTests.then: the result is an empty object
moduleContractTests.rationale: No-content responses must not attempt to parse a response body.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A response is outside the successful 2xx range.
moduleContractTests.then: the call throws an Error with message "Internal Server Error"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Failed HTTP responses must surface the response status text.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A raw response has HTTP status 204.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Raw no-content responses use a stable empty JSON representation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A raw response is outside the successful 2xx range.
moduleContractTests.then: the call throws an Error with message "Internal Server Error"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Raw HTTP failures must surface the response status text.
